summary: Independently reproduced the candidate and review. The candidate's narrow C2 boundary-state correction is valid: odd committed boundaries transfer one endpoint-local FP32 row and even boundaries transfer none, including unequal legal ring sizes. The consolidated correction preserves that implementation and its regression tests, while correcting documentation that previously described unqualified end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark support. The original full feature remains unverified and unsupported on the prepared ROCm platform.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate reproduction: 93 tests and 17 subtests passed across shared disaggregation wire behavior and the Mooncake/NIXL focused unit coverage.

Failing-before/passing-after against recorded base: ring 2 at N=101 changed from ValueError to row [6]; ring 8 at N=101 changed from five rows to [28]; ring 8 at N=102 changed from six rows to no payload.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-a4789d03d1cd/venv/bin/python inline exhaustive mapping and GPU row-copy probe (candidate 7d1a4b0)
tests.what_was_measured: 5,200 mappings across request slots, rings 2/4/8/16/32 and lengths 0..259 had zero failures; invalid rings were rejected. An AMD Instinct MI350X copied the selected 4096-byte FP32 row from source index 6 to destination index 28, exactly matched the CPU reference, and left adjacent rows untouched.
93 tests and 17 subtests passed after preserving the runtime correction and narrowing the documentation claim.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2 on AMD Instinct MI350X executed the independent C2 row-copy numerical check. This validates only row geometry and device copy behavior, not DSpark execution or generation semantics.

native_rebuild_evidence: No C, C++, CUDA, HIP, header, Cython, or other native source was changed; the correction is Python, tests, documentation, and reports only.
remaining_limitations: No end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark generation was run with Mooncake or NIXL.
Streaming and concurrent request behavior remain unverified.
Chunked prefill and prefix-cache restoration, including odd prefix hits and separation of H from N, remain unverified; decode radix cache remains explicitly incompatible with speculative decoding.
First draft/verify, partial and full rejection, accepted-token commit, C2 reuse, and Engram-history updates remain unverified end to end.
Cancellation, stale-write prevention, transfer-before-execution/source-release ordering, and request-slot reuse remain unverified.
Generation parity against non-disaggregated DeepSeek-V4.1, actual speculative acceptance, and throughput remain unmeasured.
The prepared ROCm/HIP platform cannot execute DSpark because _handle_dspark accepts only device strings beginning with cuda or npu.
No DeepSeek-V4.1 target/draft weights or real multi-process/cross-node Mooncake/NIXL topology were available.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was not substituted because it cannot qualify DeepSeek-V4.1 architecture, DSpark state semantics, speculative acceptance, or distributed transport correctness.
